listening.title: Asking for leave and handing over work

lines.speaker: Ngọc (Admin Executive)
lines.text: Hi Mr. Tuấn, do you have a moment? I'd like to ask about taking some leave.

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Office Manager)
lines.text: Of course, Ngọc. What dates are you thinking of?

lines.speaker: Ngọc (Admin Executive)
lines.text: Next Thursday and Friday. I have a family matter in my hometown, so I need two days of personal leave.

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Office Manager)
lines.text: That should be fine. But the office supply order is due on Friday. Who will handle it?

lines.speaker: Ngọc (Admin Executive)
lines.text: I've asked Duy to step in. I'll brief him on Wednesday and share the supplier list with him.

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Office Manager)
lines.text: Good. Does he know who the key contact at the supplier is?

lines.speaker: Ngọc (Admin Executive)
lines.text: Not yet. I'll write it in my handover document, together with the phone number.

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Office Manager)
lines.text: Great. Will you be able to check email while you're away?

lines.speaker: Ngọc (Admin Executive)
lines.text: I'll be unreachable on Thursday, but I can check messages on Friday evening if something is urgent.

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Office Manager)
lines.text: No problem. Please submit the request in the HR system today, and I'll approve it.
